description: Find B-roll, stock footage, music, sound effects, motion blocks, lower thirds, transitions, fonts, icons, logos, LUTs and HDRIs that an AI agent can really fetch and legally put in a video. A decision procedure over 97 databases, each tested on 2026-11-03: which ones answer an agent at all, which query works, which license holds, and when to generate instead. Includes 37 tested no-key queries, the traps (easy APIs you cannot use commercially, popular lists that break a license), and a credits file for every asset. Use for "find b-roll", "stock footage for this", "royalty free music", "free sound effects", "whoosh sound", "free video assets", "pexels api", "freesound", "which database should I use", "can I use this clip commercially", or whenever an edit needs a file it does not have. Not for references to study rather than use (find-references) or for the edit itself (edit-footage-with-code).
